headline: Congress named a Postal Service building in Purcellville, Virginia after former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 220 North Hatcher Avenue in Purcellville, Virginia. The building will be called the Secretary of State Madeleine Albright Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025.
